links.surface: أبو الحسين محمد بن هارون الزنجاني

notes: «فيما كتب إلي» («in what he wrote to me») names a written channel, not a link
«سمعت القاسم بن سلام يقول» makes Qasim a link (rule 5); his explanation of the Prophet's words is the saying, so he is the last link; the Prophet's words inside it are not a link

levels.surface: أبو الحسين محمد بن هارون الزنجاني

notes: «فيما كتب إلي» names the mode of transmission (writing), not a person
«سمعت القاسم بن سلام يقول» makes Qasim the last link: his words are the saying
The remark «وقال بعض أهل العلم» and the Prophet's saying on Fatima carry no isnad of their own and are left out of the chain
